recipes.scope: Four servings. Uses trimmed lean pork loin, 600 g cooked white rice (150 g per serving), and the named local sauce and Fineli records. Every listed marinade and brushing ingredient is conservatively counted as fully retained; this may overstate sauce actually eaten. Five-spice is excluded under its written omission bound. Practical estimate, not laboratory analysis.

Four servings. Uses trimmed lean pork loin, 600 g cooked white rice (150 g per serving), canned pineapple in its own juice drained, and all listed pan oil and sauce ingredients counted as retained. The sugar amount is fixed at the listed 2 tablespoons. Practical estimate, not laboratory analysis.

Four servings. The generic cooked chicken is resolved to 500 g cooked skinless chicken breast; broth is prepared diluted chicken stock, and cream is 38% whipping cream. All listed fats and liquids are included. Salt and unspecified white pepper are bounded as documented. Practical estimate, not laboratory analysis.

Two servings. The spinach is 150 g fresh mature spinach and the recipe now specifies 50 g yellow onion, matching the method. Eggs use 55 g edible mass each; listed pan oil is fully retained. Salt is omitted as nutrient-free for the four displayed macros. Practical estimate, not laboratory analysis.

Two servings. Uses medium tomato and fresh thyme. One teaspoon of unquantified-cultivar hot chilli is excluded under a conservative per-serving bound; listed pan oil is fully retained. Practical estimate, not laboratory analysis.

Two servings. Uses dry long-grain rice, regular-fat canned coconut milk, canned red kidney beans drained, and fresh thyme. The revised method contains no unlisted protein or garnish. Practical estimate, not laboratory analysis.
Two servings. Uses two medium shell-free eggs, a medium tomato, dry long-grain rice, chopped spring onion, and all listed pan oil counted as retained. Practical estimate, not laboratory analysis.

Two servings. The ambiguous water-or-stock choice is resolved to tap water; rice is dry long-grain white rice, eggs are 55 g edible mass each, and the exact listed ginger and spring onion are included. Practical estimate, not laboratory analysis.

Two servings. Uses dry long-grain rice, one medium 60 g carrot, one medium 350 g zucchini, one tablespoon sesame oil counted fully retained, and water rather than optional stock. Practical estimate, not laboratory analysis.
Two servings. Chickpeas are specified cooked and drained; pita is plain wheat pita, yogurt is plain unsweetened 3.9% yogurt, and tahini is unsalted. Practical estimate, not laboratory analysis.

Two servings. The recipe now lists 120 ml water required for its batter. Uses dry chickpea flour, fresh parsley, one medium yellow onion, ground cumin, and all listed pan oil counted as retained. Practical estimate, not laboratory analysis.

Two servings. Uses two medium eggs, one medium tomato, one medium green pepper, and listed pan oil fully retained. One teaspoon sumac is excluded under its written bounded seasoning scenario. Practical estimate, not laboratory analysis.

Two servings. Rice is dry long-grain white rice; the ambiguous broth-or-water choice is resolved to water. Ginger, soy sauce and spring onion amounts are listed and converted explicitly. Practical estimate, not laboratory analysis.

Two servings. Chickpeas are cooked and drained, pita is plain wheat pita, liquid is prepared diluted chicken stock, and eggs are cooked separately. The revised method uses no unlisted oil or noodles. Practical estimate, not laboratory analysis.

Two servings. Generic chicken is resolved to raw skinless breast, rice to dry long-grain white rice, and the broth-or-water choice to water. Eggs use 55 g edible mass each; unlisted optional garnishes were removed from the method. Practical estimate, not laboratory analysis.

Two servings. Fish sauce is the stored Squid Brand label record; Thai basil is represented by fresh basil AFCD record F000396 for its small 6 g amount. All listed pan oil is fully retained; the method no longer includes unlisted rice or cucumber. Practical estimate, not laboratory analysis.

Two servings. Uses raw peeled prawn flesh, dry long-grain white rice, listed fresh garlic and ginger, and diluted chicken stock. The soup recipe method was clarified to match its listed ingredients. Practical estimate, not laboratory analysis.

Two servings. Generic pork is resolved to raw 16% pork mince, rice to dry long-grain white rice, and the broth-or-water choice to water. Eggs use 55 g edible mass each; unlisted optional garnishes were removed from the method. Practical estimate, not laboratory analysis.

Two servings. Peach is specified as 150 g pitted fresh slices; pistachios were adjusted to 30 g total (15 g per serving), and the lemon is measured as one tablespoon of juice. Practical estimate, not laboratory analysis.

Four servings. The source recipe now specifies 3% cooked ham and plain 20% cream cheese, and red pepper is selected. Chives, lettuce and cucumber use their listed mass or Fineli portion conversion. Unquantified black pepper is bounded as documented. Practical estimate, not laboratory analysis.
